blocker.summary: The keyless ALFRED vintage CSV route is not reliably readable from GitHub Actions, while the official FRED/ALFRED Initial Release Only API path requires a FRED_API_KEY that is not configured in the repository.
blocker.why_it_matters: CPIAUCSL/CUSR0000SA0 can be revised through seasonal adjustment, so a leakage-free walk-forward backtest requires the vintage known at each release rather than current revised index history.

keyless_alfred_vintage_probe.finding: The first requested vintage, 2018-03-15, failed after four attempts with 60-second read timeouts; zero vintage probes completed.

official_fred_initial_release_api_probe.finding: The official FRED API route using output_type=4 (Initial Release Only) could not run because FRED_API_KEY is not configured.

bls_release_calendar_probe.finding: BLS schedule archive pages returned HTTP 403 from the GitHub runner; this route cannot currently provide a deterministic full release calendar there.

canonical_anchor.purpose: Semantic cross-check anchor only; not full-window PIT certification.

prohibited_shortcuts: Do not use current CPIAUCSL/CUSR0000SA0 history as if it were the historical vintage available at each release.
Do not replace the canonical index-derived YoY transformation with a different precomputed inflation series.
Do not use search-engine caches or unofficial mirrors as canonical vintage evidence.
Do not use arbitrary month-end vintage snapshots without exact release-availability semantics.
reopen_conditions: A FRED_API_KEY is configured and output_type=4 Initial Release Only is validated against BLS anchors and canonical live semantics, or
A deterministic official keyless vintage route becomes replayable from the validation runner.
